title: PBE0 exact-exchange integral init: OOM at 16 MPI x 3 threads; passes at 4 MPI x 12 threads; do not set a short walltime
symptom: 64-atom LCAO+PBE0 killed by SIGKILL in the integral-construction stage before SCF starts; a small Ni4 control run 'fails' at 22:20 into a 1-hour limit.
root_cause: The EXX integral initialization is memory-heavy and slow; too many MPI ranks multiply per-rank buffers, and a short walltime kills a healthy initialization.
minimal_fix: Reduce MPI replicas and raise threads (16x3 -> 4x12), keep physics inputs identical, sample memory (e.g. every 15 s into resource_samples.jsonl), and remove artificial walltime limits for the init stage.
validation: Run passed integral init into PBE0 SCF with ~240 GiB peak and no new oom_kill events; Ni4 control (exit 0, drho 4.6e-8, gap 4.64 eV) reused, not rerun.
avoid: Attributing the SIGKILL to the physics, or diagnosing 'failure' from a walltime kill.

parameters.walltime: no artificial limit on integral init
